method: Independent C++ implementation of exact two-stage multiplicative Fourier extraction on the complete 28x28 Cartier minor. The verifier was compiled with GCC 14 and run on Hugging Face cpu-xl.
conclusion: The complete coefficient [c^224 d^112] det(I-H) is 22 for square representative a=1 and 14 for nonsquare representative a=2 in both independent quadratic field models. The w=1-only and full w=1,2,3,4 answers are identical. This independently confirms the p=29 counterexample to the proposed Cartier support law.
